feeds.title: Easy Cheesy Vegetarian
feeds.description: Easy Cheesy Vegetarian is a light-hearted food blog focusing on simple vegetarian recipes. No fuss, no weird ingredients, just heaps of flavour!

feeds.title: The Flexitarian
feeds.description: Flexitarians (aka Flexible Vegetarians) have a plant-based diet. They helps you go meat free with its vegetarian and vegan recipes. Eat less meat , get healthy , save the planet.

feeds.title: Sandhya's Kitchen
feeds.description: Sandhya's Kitchen is an amalgamation of my obsession for food photography & styling along with cooking. With easy to follow recipes, I show you how to make great-tasting Vegetarian /Vegan food without the hassle.

feeds.title: Tin and Thyme
feeds.description: Featuring delicious, vegetarian and nutritious whole food recipes, including vegan, lots of baking and luscious chocolate.

feeds.title: Oh My Veg!
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Ellanor and I'm the face behind Oh My Veg. My aim is to share amazing recipes that make vegetarian cooking as easy, tasty, and nutritious as possible. Browse simple, easy and delicious vegetarian recipes from all over the world. Oh My Veg specalises in authentic Indian recipes for curries, dals, rice and desserts. Find gluten free and vegan recipes too.

feeds.title: Flavours Treat
feeds.description: I'm Geetha, an Indian living in the UK. I'm a cook, photographer, videographer, editor, and voice behind the Flavours Treat. I created this blog as a resource to find simple and real food recipes. All recipes are made with wholesome, mostly healthy, and fresh ingredients that are easily available. You will find classic and simple vegetarian recipes made from scratch using everyday ingredients.

feeds.title: Planet Veggie
feeds.description: I'm Cathy White - welcome to Planet Veggie. This blog is your go-to for exciting quick and easy vegetarian and vegan recipes that use easy-to-find ingredients.

feeds.title: The Veg Space
feeds.description: 'Ludicrously tasty' vegans and vegetarian recipes, The Veg Space is for anyone who enjoys the occasional plant-based meal or is trying to reduce the amount of meat in their diet.

feeds.title: Tinned Tomatoes
feeds.description: Tinned Tomatoes has hundreds of easy vegetarian and vegan recipes that all the family will love with printable recipes.

feeds.title: Give Me Some Spice
feeds.description: Welcome to Give Me Some Spice. It features Authentic Traditional Indian Vegetarian Recipes with step-by-step instructions by Mina Joshi. Her blog features quick and easy time saving recipes. Her mission is to share her authentic recipes.

feeds.title: simply.food
feeds.description: A blog about Vegetarian home cooking, using fresh ingredients with easy to follow step by step instructions all accompanied by original photographs. Nayna Kanabar started this recipe blog in October 2008 as a place to showcase Her recipes. She is sharing over 900 vegetarian recipes all tried, tested and created in the simplyfood kitchens.

feeds.title: The Circus Gardener's Kitchen
feeds.description: The blog about seasonal vegetarian cooking with a side helping of food politics.

feeds.title: Veggie Desserts
feeds.description: I'm Kate Hackworthy, a journalist, author and award-winning food blogger. Subscribe us to keep up with Hundreds of recipes on desserts.

feeds.title: Vegetarian Society » Recipes
feeds.description: Browse hundreds of recipes the Vegetarian Society has built to make eating vegetarianism tastier, healthier, and easier for everyone. The Vegetarian Society is the place to go for everything you want to know about the world of vegetarian food. Our mission is to inspire, inform and enable people to be vegetarian.

feeds.title: Anna Jones
feeds.description: Anna Jones is a cook, writer, the voice of modern vegetarian cooking, and the author of the bestselling A Modern Way to Eat, A Modern Way to Cook, The Modern Cook's Year, and most recently, One. Anna believes that vegetables should be put at the center of every table, and is led by the joy of food and its ability to affect change in our daily lives.
